raw_text: Russian mercenary fighters formerly operating under the Wagner Group banner have been redeployed from Syria to eastern Libya as Moscow consolidates its private military operations in Africa following the death of Yevgeny Prigozhin. Satellite imagery analysed by the BBC shows new encampments and armoured vehicle positions near the Es Sider oil terminal in Libya's Sirte Basin. The redeployment is part of a broader reorganisation of Russian PMC operations under the so-called Africa Corps, now directly controlled by Russian military intelligence.
